title: Scarium Friday, costume parades Saturday, Día de los Muertos Sunday
intro: Last weekend before Halloween. Friday night: trick-or-treat inside the Aquarium of the Pacific. Saturday: Manhattan Beach's carnival, a free library carnival in Redondo, then a costume parade and Toy Story 5 at Wilson Park. Sunday: San Pedro's free Día de los Muertos festival. Halloween itself is next Saturday, and we've got the trick-or-treat plan below. We left parking, food, and prices blank unless an official page confirmed them.

picks.name: Scarium Family Night at the Aquarium of the Pacific
picks.address: Aquarium of the Pacific, 100 Aquarium Way
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids (ages 3–11): $30.95 × 4 = $123.80 general admission (members $20.95). Kids under 3 free. Parking extra: the Aquarium's parking page lists $8 for the day with Aquarium validation; not confirmed for this evening event.
picks.parking: Aquarium parking structure: $8 for the day with Aquarium validation (official parking page). Evening-event rate not listed separately.
picks.food: The event page does not list food. Eat first or plan dinner nearby in downtown Long Beach.
picks.why: Trick-or-treat through the galleries with goodie bags, a scavenger hunt, a DJ, and vampire-magician shows. Buy tickets ahead.
picks.age_gate: All ages; kids must be with an adult 18+. No full-face masks, toy weapons, or flashlights.

picks.name: Manhattan Beach Family Halloween Carnival
picks.when: Saturday, October 24, 1:00–5:00 p.m. (costume parade 1:00 p.m. sharp; check in 15 minutes early)
picks.address: Manhattan Heights Park, 1600 Manhattan Beach Blvd
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: walking in and the costume parade are $0. The city recommends a $20 carnival bracelet per child (games, haunted house, snow cone, face painting, cupcake walk, cookie decorating, craft) → $40 for two kids. Extra activity tickets $2 each. Prices subject to change (official).
picks.parking: The city page does not list parking.
picks.food: Food booth on site (official): pizza slice $2, hot dog $2, chips $1, soda/water/juice $1, Rice Krispie treat $1.
picks.why: 38th annual city carnival with a costume parade, a haunted house, and $2 pizza. Built for ages 2–14.
picks.age_gate: Ages 2–14; kids under 6 stay with an adult
picks.price_text: Free entry; $20 carnival bracelet per child recommended

picks.name: Redondo Beach Library Halloween Carnival
picks.address: Redondo Beach Main Library, 2nd Floor Meeting Room, 303 N Pacific Coast Hwy
picks.cost_math: No price on the library's October flyer (treat as free). Parking not listed.
picks.parking: The library flyer does not list parking.
picks.why: Free indoor Halloween carnival for kids and teens. Costumes welcome. Easy morning before the afternoon parties.

picks.name: Torrance Halloween Movie in the Park
picks.when: Saturday, October 24, activities from 4:00 p.m.; Toy Story 5 starts 6:30 p.m.
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free community event (City of Torrance). Costume parade, kids' activities, DJ, and food vendors before the movie. Food is extra.
picks.parking: Wilson Park lots. The official pages do not list a fee.
picks.food: Food vendors on site (Discover Torrance). Prices not listed. The city says snacks, picnics, or takeout are welcome. Bring blankets and low-back chairs.
picks.why: Free costume parade and Toy Story 5 under the stars at Wilson Park. The easiest Halloween night out in Torrance.

picks.name: Marina Spooktacular
picks.when: Saturday, October 24 and Sunday, October 25, 4:00–10:00 p.m.
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: admission $0 with RSVP and a liability waiver (Eventbrite). Parking in a county lot: Lot #5 $5, Lot #77 $8, Lot 2 $10 → about $5–$10 for one car. Food extra.
picks.parking: County lots (official): Marina Lot #77, 13560 Mindanao Way, $8; Lot 2 / Boat Launch Ramp, 13477 Fiji Way, $10; Lot #5, 4545 Admiralty Way, $5. Marina WaterBus runs 2–11 p.m. both days, $1 per person one way (Visit Marina del Rey).
picks.food: Food trucks and treats at the event (Visit Marina del Rey). Prices not listed.
picks.why: Free harbor-side Halloween with a graveyard treasure hunt, inflatable slide, face painting, and a 5 p.m. kids' magic show. About 25–30 minutes from Torrance.
picks.age_gate: All ages; the Haunted Blackout Maze and scare zones are high-scare — skip them with little kids. Strobe lights in some areas.

picks.name: San Pedro Día de los Muertos Festival
picks.cost_math: Free, family-friendly festival (official). Food and vendor purchases extra. Downtown parking cost not listed on the event page.
picks.parking: The event page does not list parking. Expect downtown street and lot parking.
picks.food: Food vendors on site (official). Prices not listed.
picks.why: Altars, Aztec and folklórico dancers, and a Catrina contest. The 15th annual, about 20 minutes from Torrance.

picks.name: Mall-O-Ween Trick-or-Treat at Del Amo
picks.address: Del Amo Fashion Center, 3525 W. Carson Street (enter just south of Carson St near Macy's Men & Home)
picks.cost_math: Free (City of Torrance). Pre-registration required on the city page. Candy while supplies last.
picks.parking: Del Amo Fashion Center lots. The city page does not list a fee.
picks.food: Mall restaurants. No event food listed.
picks.why: Indoor trick-or-treat at the mall, rain or shine. Register first.

picks.name: Halloween on the Redondo Beach Pier
picks.when: Friday, October 30, 5:00–8:00 p.m. (trick-or-treating 5:00–6:00 p.m. while supplies last)
picks.cost_math: Free and open to the public (official). Pier parking is paid; rate not confirmed this week.
picks.parking: Pier public parking structures. Rate not confirmed on the event page.
picks.food: Pier restaurants. No event food listed.
picks.why: Free trick-or-treating with pier businesses, then a magic show, music, and crafts by the water. Weather permitting.

picks.name: Riviera Village Halloween Trick or Treat
picks.when: Saturday, October 31, 3:00–8:00 p.m. (candy until 6:00 p.m. while supplies last)
picks.address: Riviera Village, Catalina Ave (Avenue I to S. Elena St)
picks.cost_math: Free street trick-or-treat. Cashless paid parking at Plaza Riviera (1611 S Catalina Ave) and the Mira Mar Park lot; rates not listed.
picks.parking: Triangle lot between Avenida Del Norte and S. Elena, street spots, cashless paid parking at Plaza Riviera (1611 S Catalina Ave), and a paid lot at Mira Mar Park (201 Paseo de la Playa). Rates not listed.
picks.food: Village restaurants; stay for dinner (official). No event food listed.
picks.why: Halloween afternoon on a car-free Catalina Ave, the South Bay's big street trick-or-treat. Go early; candy runs out at 6.

picks.name: Long Beach Día de los Muertos Festival
picks.cost_math: Free and open to the public (City of Long Beach). Parking not listed yet; the city says more details are coming.
picks.parking: The city page does not list parking yet.
picks.food: Food vendors expected (the city is recruiting vendors). Prices not listed.
picks.why: The city's 10th annual Día de los Muertos, back as a full festival on the downtown waterfront with performances and vendors.

picks.name: Friday Fun at Madrona Marsh
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: Free. Pre-registration required by phone (310) 782-3989; opens Tuesday 10:00 a.m. the same week; first 20.
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. The official page does not list a fee.
picks.food: The official page does not list food.
picks.why: Preschool story, science, art, and a marsh tour. Call to grab a spot.

picks.name: Salt Marsh Open House at Cabrillo Marine Aquarium
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M White Dr
picks.cost_math: Free, all ages; kids must be with an adult (official). Cabrillo Beach lot is paid: $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only (per CMA's parking info).
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only.
picks.food: The event page does not list food.
picks.why: Binoculars and magnifiers with CMA educators at Cabrillo Beach's own wetland. Pairs with Sunday's festival in San Pedro.
